title: Fluidstack selects VAST Data for AI training infrastructure

sources.quote: VAST Data, the AI data platform company, today announced that Fluidstack, the premier AI cloud platform, has selected the industry-leading VAST Data Platform to join other partners in helping to power large-scale, high-performance AI workloads for Fluidstack’s global customer base.

explain: Fluidstack, which runs GPU clusters for AI labs, chose VAST Data's storage platform for the infrastructure it builds for customers. No price was disclosed.
